question: Will Bitcoin (BTC) reach $70,000 before Sep 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price reached or exceeded $70,000 at any point before Sep 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC, as reported by Binance, Coinbase, or CoinGecko.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price did not reach $70,000 at any point before Sep 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reached $70,000" means the BTC/USDT spot price traded at $70,000.00 or higher on any single reported price at any moment during the observation window.
